verdict.rationale: Intel publishes a live llms.txt at intel.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, described as 'a structured index of intel.com content optimized for AI language model discovery') that links to Core Ultra product pages relevant to this SKU, confirmed by two independent probe fetches. This is a domain-wide vendor asset rather than a per-product doc, and no dedicated agent-oriented API/docs beyond this index were found (openapi.json probes all 404). Missing for 10: product-specific llms.txt or agent docs scoped to this SKU, and richer machine-readable agent API beyond the discovery index.
